children: Italy issued 8 billion euros ($9.17 billion) in a new 12-year, October 2038-dated green BTP via a bank syndicate on Tuesday, one of the lead manager banks said.
The order book for the new government bond closed in excess of 112 billion euros, including 2.85 billion euros in joint lead manager demand, the same bank said.
The spread on the bond was set at 9 basis points above the 4.05% October 2037 BTP yield. The new BTP has a 4.40% coupon and was priced at 99.591 with a yield of 4.492%.
Lead managers were Barclays, BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, IMI-Intesa Sanpaolo, J.P. Morgan and Societe Generale.
